connector.name: Mindwtr
connector.registryDescription: Task and project automation for local Mindwtr data, with read-only self-hosted Cloud access.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mindwtr-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the dongdongbh account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: MINDWTR_DB_PATH
env.description: Optional path to the local Mindwtr SQLite database.

env.name: MINDWTR_MCP_CLOUD_URL
env.description: Optional self-hosted Mindwtr Cloud base URL for read-only Cloud mode.

env.name: MINDWTR_MCP_CLOUD_TOKEN
env.description: Bearer token for read-only self-hosted Mindwtr Cloud mode.
